question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
-- Build the complete query with top 3 bowlers
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
match_max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualifying_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN match_max_over_runs om ON o.match_id = om.match_id
    WHERE o.total_runs = om.max_runs
),
bowler_max_qualifying AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        CAST(total_runs AS INTEGER) as max_runs_in_qualifying_over
    FROM qualifying_overs
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name as bowler_name,
    bmq.match_id,
    bmq.max_runs_in_qualifying_over as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max_qualifying bmq
JOIN player p ON bmq.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bmq.max_runs_in_qualifying_over DESC
LIMIT 3;

Database: IPL

## Your task

Question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

Schema overview (columns per table; use describe_table for types/samples):
ball_by_ball: match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no, team_batting, team_bowling, striker_batting_position, striker, non_striker, bowler
batsman_scored: match_id, over_id, ball_id, runs_scored, innings_no
extra_runs: match_id, over_id, ball_id, extra_type, extra_runs, innings_no
match: match_id, team_1, team_2, match_date, season_id, venue, toss_winner, toss_decision, win_type, win_margin, outcome_type, match_winner, man_of_the_match
player: player_id, player_name, dob, batting_hand, bowling_skill, country_name
player_match: match_id, player_id, role, team_id
team: team_id, name
wicket_taken: match_id, over_id, ball_id, player_out, kind_out, innings_no

How this database is organised (written by an LLM from the tables' notes and keys):
The match table records match-level details and links to teams via team_id and players via player_id. The team and player tables record franchises and individuals. The ball_by_ball, batsman_scored, extra_runs, and wicket_taken tables record granular delivery data. These four tables connect to match via match_id and to each other using the composite key of match_id, over_id, ball_id, and innings_no. The player_match table links players to matches through match_id and player_id, while also referencing team_id. Some foreign keys, such as team_id=1 and certain player_ids, lack corresponding entries in their reference tables.

## Expected output shape
A separate planner drafted this from the question and schema. It ran no SQL and describes only the shape of the result, not values or method.
Rows (confidence: high): one row per bowler (the top 3 bowlers by runs conceded in a single over, where that over was the maximum-run over in its match) — exactly 3
The question asks to see each member, so one row per member.
Columns (confidence: high), at minimum:
  1. The name of the bowler (text)
  2. The match_id where the bowler conceded the maximum runs in a qualifying over (integer)
  3. The number of runs conceded by the bowler in that single over (integer)
Ordering: ordered by runs descending (top 3 by highest runs)
Open points for you to settle by exploring:
  - Whether ties in runs should result in more than 3 rows or be broken by some secondary criterion
  - Whether the match should be identified by match_id alone or include additional match details (teams, date, venue)
  - Whether a bowler appearing in multiple qualifying overs across different matches should be listed once (with their best over) or multiple times

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
match_max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualifying_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN match_max_over_runs om ON o.match_id = om.match_id
    WHERE o.total_runs = om.max_runs
),
bowler_max_qualifying AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        CAST(total_runs AS INTEGER) as max_runs_in_qualifying_over
    FROM qualifying_overs
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name as bowler_name,
    bmq.match_id,
    bmq.max_runs_in_qualifying_over as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max_qualifying bmq
JOIN player p ON bmq.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bmq.max_runs_in_qualifying_over DESC
LIMIT 3;
